title: Pure Libromancer
summary: Libromancer cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Libromancer is a Ritual deck. The Main Deck monsters summon themselves by revealing a Ritual Monster in the hand. Libromancer Geek Boy then searches a Libromancer Spell, and Libromancer Fire a Libromancer monster. A Ritual Monster summoned with monsters from the field gets a bonus: Firestarter can't be destroyed or banished by effects, Fireburst doubles its battle damage, and Mystigirl shields your Rituals and negates a monster. Libromancer First Appearance searches a monster and Ritual Summons every turn, and Magigirl Ritual Summons on the opponent's turn. Libromancer Origin Story, the newest card, Sets a Libromancer Spell/Trap from the Deck and destroys their Spell/Trap on each Ritual Summon. Libromancer Intervention negates by returning a Ritual Monster to the hand.
